title: Some New Sufficient Conditions for a Graph to be $l$-Deficient
summary: For a (molecular) graph $G$ and any real number $α\ne 0$ , the zero-order general Randić index , denote by $^0R_α$, is defined by the following equation: \begin{align*} {^0R_α} (G) =\sum_{v\in G}d_G (v) ^α (α\in \mathbb{R}-\left\{0\right\}) . \end{align*} The deficiency of $G$, denoted by $def(G)$, is equal to the cardinality of vertices which are not covered by a maximum matching in $G$. A graph G is called $l$-deficient if $def(G)\le l$.
